rationale: Codex is the only pin with no defect I could find on the real (non-injected) manual path: it resolves agent roots against the config directory, emits a COORD_ISSUE unset that real tmux accepts, requires the workspace group for every manual name, and guards all four automated entry points including coord run and coord attach - whereas my own pin fails fatally twice on that path (unresolved relative agent roots and invalid set-environment argv, both masked by an injected manualUi), and antigravity leaves coord run unguarded, gates manual title-closing on tmux liveness, pins the unscoped coord-manual name in a test, and left config.product.example.json at 0.0.11.
